product_updates.title: Science Corporation implants its vision-restoring chip in its first Stargardt disease patient
product_updates.content: Max Hodak, the former president and co-founder of Neuralink, detailed on stage at TechCrunch Disrupt how his company's work with PRIMA is part of its path toward a novel brain-computer interface (BCI).

product_updates.title: Cerebras CEO says we’re nearing a future where everyone has a personal AI assistant at home
product_updates.content: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman predicts a future where personal AI assistants become as commonplace as household appliances, running partly on local devices and partly in the cloud.

product_updates.title: Industrial Next wants factory robots to switch tasks in minutes, not weeks
product_updates.content: Industrial Next helps manufacturers automate complex, delicate tasks that have traditionally required human labor.

product_updates.title: Cerebras CEO pushes back on AI doomsday warnings
product_updates.content: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman has a message for AI leaders spreading doomsday warnings: Maybe stop talking? At TechCrunch Disrupt, he argued that the industry's focus on AI's risks is drowning out its potential benefits.

product_updates.title: Judge orders OpenAI to turn over hiring records in Apple trade secrets case
product_updates.content: A federal judge ruled that Apple can access OpenAI's interview materials involving former Apple employees, as well as private messages and testimony from key figures in the case.

product_updates.title: Flox Intelligence is building AI to keep wildlife away from trains, airports, and roads
product_updates.content: Flox's edge devices can identify animals and use species-specific sounds to drive them away from critical infrastructure.

product_updates.title: Facebook is giving users more control over their algorithm
product_updates.content: Meta announced the launch of its new AI-powered feature, “Your Algorithm,” a feature it first launched on Instagram.

product_updates.title: Laplace Intelligence red-teams robots and self-driving cars before they hit the real world
product_updates.content: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles before deployment. The profitable startup is competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt, October 13-15 in San Francisco.

product_updates.title: Pluto Security raises $42M as AI gives enterprise security teams a new headache
product_updates.content: The problem with giving everyone in a company access to AI tools is that people will use them in unexpected ways. And that fact is steadily seeding fears that companies now have new, gaping security holes in their systems or, at least, will soon.

product_updates.title: Google Play now lets anyone build private, vibe-coded apps that run on Android
product_updates.content: Google is making it easier to build and use personal Android apps created with AI, without having to make them available to everyone on the Play Store.

technical_breakthroughs.content: Topgolf and VMware "ran deep" before the migration.
